Bũmb ning sẽn be saasẽ la bũmb ning sẽn be Tẽngẽ yɩlgda Wẽnde, sẽn yaa Naabã, n yaa yɩlgr Naabã, n yaa wilb Naaba, n yaa yam-bedr Soaba.

Yẽ la Soab ning sẽn tʋms zu-sablẽ wã Tẽn-tʋʋma, sẽn yi bãmb pʋgẽ t'a karemd-b A Aayayã bãmb zug la a yɩlgd bãmb la a wilgd bãmb gafã la bãngr sẽn nafde, la pĩnda, bãmb ra yɩɩme n be meneng pʋgẽ sẽn vẽnege.
La neb a taab me nengẽ sẽn yi bãmb pʋgẽ b na n pa wa nand ye, la Yẽnda la zɩslem Naaba, n yaa yam-bedr Soaba.
Ad woto yaa Wẽnd yɩɩdlem t'A kõt A sẽn rat a soaba, la Wẽnd la yɩɩdlem sẽn yaa bedr Soaba.

Neb nins b sẽn rogl-b rãmb Taooraatã, rẽ poorẽ tɩ b pa zã-a wã, b bilgr yaa wala bõang sẽn zɩlg gaf-bεd bilgri. Neb nins sẽn yagsd Wẽnd Aayayã bilgr yɩ wẽnga, la Wẽnd pa kãndgd neb nins sẽn yaa wẽgdbã ye.
Yeele: "yaa yãmb neb nins sẽn yaa Yahʋʋd-rãmba! Yãmb sã n yẽgmame tɩ yãmb yaa Wẽnd waliimba (nong-n-tɑɑse) tɩ nebã pa lagme, bɩ y tʋll kũumã tɩ yãmb sã n yaa sɩd rãmba".
La b kõn n tʋll-a lae-lae, b nusã sẽn tʋm tɩ reng taoorã yĩnga, la Wẽnd yaa Mit ne Wẽgdbã.
Yeele: "ad kũum ning yãmb sẽn zoet n zãagdẽ wã, a yekda yãmba, rẽ poorẽ b na n lebsa yãmb n kẽng sẽn solg la sẽn vẽneg Mitã nengẽ, t'A kõ yãmb kibar ne bũmb ning yãmb sẽn da tʋmdã.
Yãmb ɑ neb nins sẽn kõ sɩd ne Wẽnde! B sã n wa bool tɩ y wa pʋʋs arzũmã raare, bɩ y yãg n tʋg Wẽnd yʋʋrã tẽegrẽ la y bas koosmã; yãmb maan-kãng la sõma ne yãmb tɩ yãmb sã n da miẽ.
La Pʋʋsgã sã n wa sε, bɩ y sãeeg Tẽngã zugu, la y bao Wẽnd yɩɩdlem, la y tẽeg Wẽnd yell wʋsgo sãnd-sãnde y na paam tɩlgre.
La b sã n yã koosem maa reem, la b sẽn yelg n tʋg be la b bas foom tɩ f yãsẽ, yeele: "bũmb ning sẽn be Wẽnd nengẽ wã sõmblem n yɩɩd reem la koosem, la Wẽnde, Yẽ n yɩɩd rɩlgdbã fãa ne sõmblem".
